units.action: Introduce Milo on the stream bank, then show the berry bush, hollow log and his longer-than-usual wander.
Food montage within this long narrator line: seeds in grass, berries beside the stream, then the acorn.
Same stream-bank geography at sunset; Milo notices the light, speaks, and leaves the acorn by the stone.
Establish both routes around the boulder; Milo looks from left meadow branch to right shortcut.
Milo chooses the right branch and speaks without moving to a new background.
Milo enters and hurries along the established shortcut path.
Separate view of Milo passing the left mossy stone, feet on dirt lane.
Separate view of Milo ducking under the fallen branch, same plate.
Separate view of Milo curving around the stump, same plate.
Milo runs right on the same foreground lane, past the stump and toward the next location cut; no reversal into the rear opening.
Establish Leo asleep; show mane on grass, closed eyes and paw blocking path as details of one tree clearing.
Milo rounds the root and blurts out his startled line.
Trip over the paw, one tumble, and landing against Leo’s nose.
Leo’s eyes open; cut closer on his face for his spoken question while tree geometry remains behind him.
Leo lifts his head and places a paw beside Milo, blocking the same path.
Hold the scale contrast as Milo freezes; both remain grounded.
Leo speaks from his existing position, Milo listens.
Milo apologizes and explains; Leo listens without lip motion.
Leo considers his strength and softens while Milo waits.
Leo speaks gently and lets Milo leave.
Milo reacts in surprised relief and speaks.
Leo reassures him; then narration holds on Milo’s reaction.
Milo thanks Leo and promises to pass kindness on.
Leo sends Milo home; reveal the open path and evening light.
Milo heads home more carefully on the known shortcut.
Days pass; Milo resumes routine on the path to his burrow.
Leo rests again beneath the established great tree.
Empty established shortcut path foreshadows the next meeting; no newly designed forest.
Leo approaches the same leaf-covered flax-rope trigger loop on the trap path; its rope connects to the folded net overhead. His small step causes only a small size change.
The trigger releases the same overhead net onto Leo; mesh falls around his body, his face and paws remain clear, and he looks surprised.
Leo tests the ropes and speaks in frustration while remaining at the same trap position.
He calls for help; closer face view then echo over the same forest path.
Milo hears the call, recognizes Leo and speaks on the morning run path.
Run montage over roots, between bushes and under branches, each a view of the one approved path.
Milo continues toward the bright opening and recedes smoothly as narration explains his purpose.
Milo arrives at the same trap clearing and sees Leo in the net.
Leo warns Milo about the ropes; Milo listens.
Milo studies the mesh and moves toward the single closure loop.
Milo proposes using his teeth.
Leo asks about the teeth.
Milo answers playfully before any rope is cut.
Milo steadies and gnaws the one closure strand; intercut close details without shifting Leo or the plate.
Fibres fray and the same rope parts.
Milo steps clear; opening widens; Leo exits and net falls behind him.
Freed Leo thanks Milo and Milo jokes; hold their established left/right places.
Leo asks why Milo returned; Milo answers; Leo suggests repayment.
Milo rejects the debt idea; Leo asks what he means.
Milo explains kindness and the hope that it passes onward.
Leo reflects silently; use a face detail and a grounded shared view for his smile.
Later at the great tree, the friends rest, joke and laugh in daylight.
Hold the friends beneath the same tree as the narrator recalls and states the kindness lesson.
Closing gentle view of the pair and tree; no extra destination or narrator figure.
